issues.description: Method Course.getAverageRating(): the problem statement (and the template stub) specify the method should return Double, but the solution implementation defines getAverageRating() with return type Float. This mismatch (Double vs Float) across artifacts can confuse students implementing the method to match the template/problem and may cause type mismatches in client code or tests that expect a Double.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the return type consistent across all artifacts. Preferred fix: update the solution implementation to match the problem and template by changing the signature to func getAverageRating() -> Double and compute the average using Double (e.g. Double(starSum) / Double(totalRatings)). Alternatively, if Float is desired, update the problem statement and template stub to require Float and adjust their examples accordingly.
